name: PORT_SOUND_CODE
note: read: the command byte from the 68k (and acknowledges the NMI); write: clears it (NeoGeoDev wiki Z80 port map)

name: PORT_YM_ADDR_A
note: YM2610 address port A

name: PORT_YM_DATA_A
note: YM2610 data port A

name: PORT_YM_ADDR_B
note: YM2610 address port B

name: PORT_YM_DATA_B
note: YM2610 data port B

name: PORT_NMI_ENABLE
note: write: enables the NMI (command from the 68k); read: bank $F000-$F7FF

name: PORT_REPLY
note: write: the reply byte the 68k reads in REG_SOUND

name: PORT_NMI_DISABLE
note: write: disables the NMI

name: PORT_C0
note: mirror of port $00 (only address bits 2-3 decoded, wiki); Init writes 1 to it

name: Reset
note: di, jp Init

name: RstDelayShort
note: rst 08h: jp DelayShort

name: RstDelay
note: rst 10h: jp Delay

name: RstYmWriteA
note: rst 18h: jp YmWriteA

name: RstYmWriteB
note: rst 20h: jp YmWriteB

name: RstSystemCommand
note: rst 28h: jp SystemCommand

name: IrqVector
note: mode 1 interrupt (the YM2610 timers, wiki): di, jp TimerIrq

name: VersionText
note: Ver 1.5b by Mr.Pac h Ber.02/01/08 (the signature on the wiki SM1 page)

name: Nmi
note: command from the 68k: 1, 3 and $10 are handled at once (NmiPrepareSwitch, NmiReset, NmiCommand10); 0 is ignored; any other is queued in CommandQueue (or put straight in SoundCommand while CommandWait is set); then the reply (ReplyValue with bit 7) and the port $00 clear. MAME: every command of the hardware test and the boot

name: NmiExit
note: restores the registers and retn

name: Init
note: stack $FFFC, interrupt mode 1, clears the 2 KB of RAM, sets SoundLock, writes 1 to port $C0 and YM2610 registers $27, $10, $1C, enables the NMI (port $08) and enters MainLoop. Run at every reset (MAME)

name: MainLoop
note: takes the next queued command (CommandQueue, QueueRead) and runs it (TakeCommand); while RandomReplyOn is set, sends a random reply (ld a,r | $80) to port $0C

name: TakeCommand
note: marks the queue entry free, SoundCommand = the command, then DispatchCommand

name: DispatchCommand
note: CommandTypeTable[SoundCommand]: 1 system command (rst 28h), 2 a sound or tune (PlaySoundCommand), 5 the coin sound (CoinSound); types 3 and 4 ($01C4, $048E) are handled but no command has them; 0 ignored

name: PlaySoundCommand
note: command type 2 ($5C-$5F): jp PlaySound with the command

name: ClearCommandQueue
note: clears QueueRead / QueueWrite and the 16 bytes of CommandQueue

name: SystemCommand
note: SoundCommand x 3 into SystemCommandTable, jp (hl)

name: SystemCommandTable
note: 26 jp, one per system command 0-25 (CommandTypeTable gives type 1 to 1-9 and $10 only)

name: NmiPrepareSwitch
note: command 1, from the NMI: clears the reply and the code, resets the stack and returns (retn) into PrepareSwitch

name: NmiReset
note: command 3, from the NMI: same, into SoftReset

name: NmiCommand10
note: command $10, from the NMI: resets the stack and returns into Command10

name: CommandNone
note: system command 0 (and the unused entries): ret

name: Command2Eyecatcher
note: command 2: plays sound $5F through PlaySound (the eyecatcher jingle: MAME, recorded and compared with the jingle of Sengoku 2's own M1: same envelope, correlation 0.9996)

name: PrepareSwitch
note: command 1: keys off and silences every YM2610 channel, writes jp $FFFD at $FFFD in RAM, replies 1 and jumps there: the Z80 waits in RAM while the 68k changes the Z80 ROM (MAME: Z80 at $FFFD after command 1)

name: SoftReset
note: command 3: SoftResetFlag = 1, clears the reply and the code, jp Reset (MAME: the next instruction traced is $0000, in the newly selected ROM)

name: Command7Enable
note: command 7: clears the queue, silences the YM2610 (SilenceAll) and clears SoundLock and $FE31: after a reset, $5C-$5F play only once 7 has been sent (MAME). The hardware test sends 3 then 7 for SOUND OFF and on entering the sound test

name: Command10SelfTest
note: command $10: self test, flags in the shadow a' starting at $80: bit 0 ROM sum of $0000-$EFFF against RomChecksum, bit 1 RAM $55/$AA, bit 2 RAM address test; then Command10Reply. SP-S2 never sends it; MAME: reply 1 (all passed)

name: SilenceAll
note: YM2610 register writes that silence the channels (called by Init and Command7StopAll)

name: DelayShort
note: ret: the time of the rst itself

name: Delay
note: push and pop bc, de, hl: a slightly longer delay between YM2610 accesses

name: TimerIrq
note: YM2610 timer interrupt: saves the registers and runs the sound engine

name: YmWriteA
note: writes YM2610 register d = e through port A ($04, $05), with rst 08h / 10h waits

name: YmWriteB
note: same through port B ($06, $07)

name: PlaySound
note: starts sound SoundCommand: resets ADPCM-B (YM2610 register $10) and sets up the channels from SoundTable entry SoundCommand - $20. While SoundLock is set it goes to $118A and nothing is heard. MAME, no cartridge: $5D right channel only, $5C left only, $5E both (the RIGHT / LEFT / CENTER of the sound test), $5F the eyecatcher jingle

name: SoundTable
note: pointers per sound, index command - $20 (PlaySound)

name: CoinSound
note: command type 5 ($7F): the coin sound (MAME: a short sound, about a second)

name: SequenceCommandTable
note: 48 jp: the commands of the music sequence interpreter, by character - '0' (x 3)

name: CommandTypeTable
note: 256 bytes, the type of each command: 1 for 1-9 and $10, 2 for $5C-$5F, 5 for $7F, 0 for the rest

name: SoundCommand
note: the command being run

name: SoundCommandType
note: its CommandTypeTable value

name: QueueRead
note: next CommandQueue entry to run (0-7)

name: QueueWrite
note: next free CommandQueue entry (0-7)

name: CommandQueue
note: 8 entries of 2 bytes: $FF while waiting, then the command

name: CommandWait
note: set while a command waits for the previous one (loop at $0C3D); the NMI then stores the command straight in SoundCommand

name: RandomReplyOn
note: cleared by most system commands; MainLoop sends random replies while it is set

name: SoundLock
note: $FF from Init and commands 4 and 5: PlaySound plays nothing until command 7 or 8 clears it (MAME)

name: InRamLoop
note: 1 while the Z80 waits in RAM after command 1 (PrepareSwitch)

name: SoftResetFlag
note: set to 1 by SoftReset before jumping to Reset

name: ReplyValue
note: random value (ld a,r) sent with bit 7 as the reply after each command

name: RamLoop
note: jp $FFFD, written by PrepareSwitch: the Z80 loops here during a ROM switch

name: SsgPeriodA
note: start of the 2 KB RAM (cleared by Init); word: SSG period kept for channel 5 (command 5Fh reads it)

name: SsgPeriodB
note: word: the same for channel 6

name: SsgPeriodC
note: word: the same for channel 7

name: SsgSlideA
note: 11-byte block of channel 5 set by command 5Fh (flag, period, step); cleared by Init

name: SsgSlideB
note: the same for channel 6

name: SsgSlideC
note: the same for channel 7

name: LoopStacks
note: loop counters and return addresses of commands 31h/32h and 34h/38h, 16 bytes per channel (base + channel x 16, sub_27DD)

name: CallStacks
note: return addresses of commands 35h/36h (call, return), 16 bytes per channel

name: TimerAShadow
note: copy of the timer A value: +4 YM $24, +5 YM $25 (command 37h)

name: FmShadowA
note: FM operator register copies of channels 1-2 (port A), written by the instrument loader sub_162E

name: FmShadowB
note: the same for channels 3-4 (port B)

name: ChannelOwner
note: one byte per channel number (0-14): written by sub_28EC with b & 7 when a sound takes the channel

name: Channel1
note: 16-byte block of song channel 1 (FM): +0 flags, +9/+10 sequence pointer, +11/+12 sequence start (PlaySound)

name: Channel2
note: song channel 2 (FM)

name: Channel3
note: song channel 3 (FM)

name: Channel4
note: song channel 4 (FM)

name: Channel8
note: song channel 8 (ADPCM-A)

name: Channel9
note: song channel 9 (ADPCM-A)

name: Channel10
note: song channel 10 (ADPCM-A)

name: Channel11
note: song channel 11 (ADPCM-A)

name: Channel12
note: song channel 12 (ADPCM-A)

name: Channel13
note: song channel 13 (ADPCM-A)

name: Channel14
note: song channel 14 (ADPCM-B)

name: EffectChannel5
note: effect channel 5 (SSG A), sub_0881

name: EffectChannel6
note: effect channel 6 (SSG B)

name: EffectChannel7
note: effect channel 7 (SSG C)

name: EffectChannel0
note: effect channel 0

name: ExtraChannel0
note: another channel block (type 5 path at $0841)

name: ExtraChannel5
note: channel blocks of the type 3 sounds ($03D0), SSG A

name: ExtraChannel6
note: SSG B

name: ExtraChannel7
note: SSG C

name: EffectPlaying
note: $FF while an effect plays (sub_0881)

name: EffectPriority
note: priority of the playing effect: a lower one is refused (sub_0881)

name: EffectParam
note: effect header byte +13 (sub_0881); also command 51h

name: EngineStack
note: stack pointer saved by TimerIrq; commands 40h, 47h and 55h restore it to leave the channel

name: Tempo
note: song header byte +23, also command 33h; applied by sub_28FE

name: NoNewCommand
note: $FF once TakeCommand has taken the command; the NMI clears it

name: CurrentChannel
note: the channel number the engine is working on (0-14)

name: EffectCommand
note: the command number of the effect being started (sub_0881)

name: StackTop
note: initial stack pointer (Init and the system commands)

name: SequenceStep
note: reads the channel's sequence at hl: notes ($01-$30, $00 escape), commands ($31-$5F through SequenceCommandTable), instruments ($80-$FF); format in tools/sm1_data.py

name: LoadInstrument
note: writes FM instrument a (52-byte record of FmInstruments, a x 52) to the channel's operators and to the register copies FmShadowA/B

name: SetTempo
note: applies Tempo (song header +23 and command 33h)

name: StartEffect
note: starts effect SoundCommand - $60 from EffectTable on channels 5, 6, 7 and 0, unless a higher-priority effect plays (CoinSound)

name: SeqNop
note: sequence commands 30h, 3Ch, 3Eh, 48h, 49h, 4Ah: nothing

name: SeqLoopStart
note: commands 31h, 32h: push a loop (count byte) on the channel's LoopStacks entry

name: SeqLoopEnd
note: commands 34h, 38h: back to the loop start until the count runs out

name: SeqCall
note: command 35h: call the sub-sequence at the word that follows (CallStacks)

name: SeqReturn
note: command 36h: return from a sub-sequence

name: SeqJump
note: command 39h: reads a word at hl without the exx the other commands do, so it would read its operand from $226D; no sequence uses it

name: SeqTempo
note: command 33h: tempo byte (SetTempo)

name: SeqTimerA
note: command 37h: two bytes to YM2610 $25 and $24 (timer A), kept in TimerAShadow

name: SeqVolume
note: command 3Ah: byte - $88 to the channel's +7

name: SeqEnd
note: command 40h: silences the channel and leaves it (EngineStack)

name: SeqHalt
note: command 41h: di / halt: would stop the Z80; no sequence uses it

name: SeqRepeat
note: command 42h: back to the start of the sequence (+11/+12 to +9/+10)

name: SeqStartSound
note: command 47h: starts another sound (PlaySound entry sub_0EF3) and leaves the channel

name: SeqLfo
note: command 4Eh: byte to YM2610 $22 (LFO)

name: SeqYmWrite
note: command 50h: register, value to YM2610 port A

name: SeqSsgEnvelope
note: command 53h: three bytes to YM2610 $0D, $0B, $0C (SSG envelope shape and period)

name: SeqEffectEnd
note: command 55h: ends the effect channel (EffectPlaying cleared) and leaves it

name: SoundLeft
note: sound $5C, the sound test's LEFT: only channel 1 has notes (MAME: left output only)

name: SoundRight
note: sound $5D, RIGHT

name: SoundCenter
note: sound $5E, CENTER

name: SoundEyecatcher
note: sound $5F, the eyecatcher jingle (command 2): FM channels 1-4

name: EffectCoin
note: effect $7F, the coin sound: SSG channels 5-7

name: EffectTable
note: pointers per effect, commands $60-$7F (StartEffect); only $7F is filled

name: FmInstruments
note: 103 FM instruments of 52 bytes (LoadInstrument)

name: AlgorithmCarriers
note: per FM algorithm (0-7): bits of the operators whose level the instrument does not set (the carriers)

name: TimerATable
note: 7 timer A values (YM $25/$24)

name: SpecialEffect
note: an effect number ($00 here): StartEffect sets $FE40 = 4 when the effect started is this one, and command 55h checks $FE40 = 4

name: FmFnumTable
note: FM F-numbers ($26A-$4B0) by note index bits 0-4 (12 notes in 16 slots)

name: SsgPeriodTable
note: SSG tone periods by note index bits 0-4

name: RomChecksum
note: checksum byte: the sum of $0000-$EFFF (this byte included) is $D4 (Command10SelfTest; checked here: $D4)

name: Command4StopAll
note: command 4: clears the queue, keys off the FM channels, silences SSG and ADPCM, then locks both music (SoundLock) and effects (EffectLock). Run in MAME

name: Command5StopMusic
note: command 5: clears the queue, keys off the FM channels and locks the music (SoundLock). Run in MAME

name: Command6StopEffects
note: command 6: clears the queue, stops ADPCM-B, silences the SSG and locks the effects (EffectLock). Run in MAME

name: Command8EnableMusic
note: command 8: clears SoundLock (music allowed again). Run in MAME

name: Command9EnableEffects
note: command 9: clears EffectLock. Run in MAME

name: Command10Reply
note: end of Command10SelfTest: replies 1 when every test passed (flags still $80), else 0, then jp Reset. MAME: command $10 replied 1 about 64 frames later

name: ClearSsgSlides
note: clears the first byte of SsgSlideA/B/C

name: FmKeyOffAll
note: YM2610 register $28 (key on/off) = $01, $02, $05, $06: the four FM channels off

name: SsgSilence
note: SSG volumes (YM $08, $09, $0A) = 0, unless $FE40 = 4

name: AdpcmKeyOff
note: YM2610 port B register $00 (ADPCM-A key) dumps and SSG mixer writes

name: AdpcmBStop
note: if an ADPCM-B sound plays: YM2610 $10 reset and $1C flag writes, clears its flags

name: QueueCheckFull
note: steps QueueWrite on when it has reached $FE5C

name: PlaySoundA
note: plays sound a ($20-$5F), refused while SoundLock is set (PlaySound and SeqStartSound enter here)

name: UpdateSsgSlides
note: per frame, for the three SsgSlide blocks in use (none while EffectLock is set)

name: FmKeyOn
note: keys on FM channel a: register $28 with the operator mask, then the F-number from FmFnumTable

name: SsgNoteOn
note: SSG channel a: tone period from SsgPeriodTable, mixer register $07

name: SsgSetNoise
note: SSG noise period (YM $06) and mixer bits (YM $07) from EffectParam

name: SsgSlideActive
note: carry set when the SsgSlide block of channel a (5-7) is in use

name: ChannelKeyOn
note: note on for CurrentChannel by kind: FM (1-4) FmKeyOn, SSG (5-7) SsgNoteOn, ADPCM-A (8-13), ADPCM-B (14)

name: YmTimerControl35
note: YM2610 register $27 (timer control) = $35

name: YmTimerControl1F
note: register $27 = $1F

name: YmTimerControl2F
note: register $27 = $2F

name: LoadModulation
note: copies the instrument's bytes +42 to +48 into the channel's ModulationBlocks entry (vibrato or envelope)

name: Multiply
note: de = e x b (e signed), by repeated addition

name: FmWriteLevels
note: writes the operator levels of FM channel a from the register copies

name: UpdateModulation
note: per tick for FM channels 1-4: steps the ModulationBlocks entry

name: StartModulation
note: restarts the channel's ModulationBlocks entry at a new note

name: ModulationBlock
note: iy = ModulationBlocks + b x 16

name: AdpcmBFade
note: steps the ADPCM-B volume (YM $1B) down by $FE1E while $FE1D is set

name: TransposeNote
note: pitch nibble a plus b semitones: NoteSemitoneTable turns the nibble into a semitone, SemitoneNoteTable back into a nibble with the octave carry ($20)

name: NoteSemitoneTable
note: semitone of each pitch nibble: C=$C, C#=1, D=$D, D#=2, E=$E, F=$F, F#=4, G=0, G#=5, A=$A, A#=6, B=$B (3, 7, 8, 9 unused): the nibble spells the note name

name: SemitoneNoteTable
note: pitch nibble of semitones 0-23 (+$20 for the next octave)

name: ChannelTick
note: counts the channel's note times down (+4 then +5) and keys the note off

name: ChannelPitch
note: pitch of the channel: TransposeNote of +6 by +7, plus +13, +14 and the octave bits of +0

name: SeqSetLevel
note: first optional instrument byte: level (- $88 on FM and SSG, - $80 on ADPCM-A unless $FE23, - $B8 on ADPCM-B) to +2

name: SeqSetParam15
note: third optional instrument byte - $B8 to +15

name: SeqSetDetune
note: second optional instrument byte: a signed step (bit 0 the sign) to +14

name: SetPanBits
note: command 44h path: the channel's 2 high bits (left/right) into its register copy

name: ChannelStackEntry
note: hl += CurrentChannel x 16 (LoopStacks, CallStacks), with channels 11-13 and 16 remapped while $FC38 is set

name: AddTimes3
note: hl += a x 3

name: NoteLengthTimes
note: turns the length byte into the two counters +4/+5 (gate and note), scaled by the channel's ChannelOwner value

name: SetChannelOwner
note: ChannelOwner[a] = b & 7

name: SetTimerA
note: TimerATable[a & $0F] to YM2610 $25 and $24, kept in TimerAShadow

name: FmSetTotalLevel
note: writes FM channel a's operator total levels ($40+) for level b

name: FmWriteOp1
note: operator register +$00 of the FM channel (copy at +16)

name: FmWriteOp3
note: operator register +$08 (copy at +24)

name: FmWriteOp2
note: operator register +$04 (copy at +20)

name: FmWriteOp4
note: operator register +$0C (copy at +28)

name: FmWriteOperator
note: writes register a + l, value b, through the port pair in c'

name: SsgWriteLevel
note: SSG volume: register a + 3 (8, 9, 10 for channels 5, 6, 7) = b

name: ModulationBlocks
note: 16-byte block per channel (ModulationBlock), loaded from the instrument (LoadModulation)

name: EffectLock
note: set by commands 4 and 6, cleared by 7 and 9: effects are refused while it is set

name: TickParamsA
note: per-tick routine on the block $FA88-$FAA3 (counters $FA9C, $FAA3): runs in MAME, purpose not found

name: TickParamsB
note: per-tick routine on $FA8E-$FA96 (a word step): runs in MAME, purpose not found
